(TRIVALENT) # MACHINING: 3.2( 0.8) # WEIGHT(Kg ): 0.01 kg"}],"comment":"Dimension D6 on page 1 has a tolerance band of 0.008 mm (-0.004/-0.012), which is less than 0.1 mm, and note N1 on page 1 specifies an I.Z.B.P. plating finish; the drawing does not state whether the 6 mm diameter is before or after plating. Without accounting for plating thickness, the pin may be oversized after finishing and fail to assemble into its mating hole. The designer should add a note specifying that the dimension applies before plating, or adjust the toleranced size to allow for the coating thickness."
    ,"recommended_correction":"Add a note such as 'DIMENSION D6 APPLIES BEFORE PLATING' or reduce the nominal/tolerance by twice the specified plating thickness."}]}
